sql.query: SELECT TOP (?) ILL_NO, COMPANY , RPRSTT_KR , CP_ADDR , CP_JIBUN , CPTEL, CPFAX, rnum,tot_cnt FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY ILL_NO ) AS rnum, count(*) over() tot_cnt, A.* FROM TB_MB_MASTER A WHERE hcode = ? AND scode = '10' $addWhere ) x WHERE rnum > (?-1) * ?

mapping.getProperty: ILL_NO, COMPANY , RPRSTT_KR , CP_ADDR , CP_JIBUN , CPTEL, CPFAX, rnum,tot_cnt

sql.query: SELECT cp_code, fyear, ill_no, substring(field_name,2,4) field_name, month_fee, month_in, jan_amt from FN_MB_FEE_IN_JAN(?,?,?) union all SELECT cp_code, fyear, ill_no, '99' field_name, sum(month_fee) month_fee, sum(month_in) month_in, null jan_amt from FN_MB_FEE_IN_JAN(?,?,?) where field_name != 'F00' group by cp_code, fyear, ill_no

mapping.getProperty: cp_code, fyear , ill_no , field_name , month_fee , month_in, jan_amt
